title: The samples a set plays travel with it (collected, or referenced in place, or from a library)
description:
As a producer, I want the samples a set uses to travel with it, so that I can move the folder to another machine and it still opens.

```gherkin
Feature: Samples travel with the set
  Background:
    Given the samples "a/horn.wav" and "b/horn.wav"
    And a score "two.apr" that plays both

  Scenario: Samples are collected into the set folder
    When I export "two.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the folder "two Project/Samples/Imported" holds a copy of each sample the score plays
    And every clip refers to its sample by a path relative to the set
    And samples the score does not play are not copied

  Scenario: Two samples with the same file name do not collide
    When I export "two.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the two copies have different file names
    And each clip refers to the copy of its own sample

  Scenario: Referencing samples where they are
    When I export "two.apr" as a DAW set with "--no-collect"
    Then no samples are copied
    And every clip refers to its sample's absolute path

  Scenario: Exporting from a library
    Given a library holding the samples of "two.apr"
    When I export "two.apr" as a DAW set with "--library" set to that library
    Then the export succeeds
    And the collected samples are the library's files
```
